The gas generator of the driver's airbag may malfunction if it has been exposed to high humidity and high temperature fluctuations for many years.
The plug connection from the wiring harness to the blower controller may deteriorate over time.

In 2019, BMW decided on a safety-relevant recall for certain vehicles of the E46 (3 series) with a driver's airbag with a singlestage gas generator of the "NADI" type. According to the findings, gas generators of this type from a production period specified by the supplier could leak in the long term.
The hydraulic unit was produced incorrectly.
Possibly no PDC sound output when inserting R.
A malfunction in the diagnosis of the tank ventilation was detected in the vehicles. This results in a fault memory entry during the first fault detection.
The hexagon nuts (copper nuts) on the holder of the catalytic converter (near the engine) were tightened to an incorrect torque.
The driver's airbag is equipped with a "NADI" type single-stage gas generator. There have been indications that this type of gas generator can leak in the long term.
The broken rod leads to a significant impairment of the vehicle's ease of steering. The track rods may break due to increased vibration loads.

In the M6, the high-mounted brake light is mounted on the standard CFRP roof using six screw connections. Due to the setting properties of CFRP under pressure and heat, the screw connections lose their preload force and rattle under dynamic stimulation while driving.
The upper (roof‐side) rear spoiler of X6 consists of a carrier plate on which the outer shell of the spoiler is bonded. The cause is poor bonding.
Hall sensor can switch out due to a too short wiring. With a switched-out Hall sensor, the Airbag for Driver or Passenger won’t work correctly in case of an accident.
Due to a fault in the downstream catalytic converter oxygen sensor heating, the OBD (on-board diagnosis) relevant diagnoses are disabled.

Due to an error in the manufacturing process of the supplier, on oil hoses of the oil cooler (inlet and outlet)crack may come up where the oil hose connects with the oil pipe. In case of cracks, a small amount of oil may leak. The oil cooler needs to be replaced. BMW Motorrad has not received any reports and is not aware of any injuries or fatalities related to the issue.

Due to a fault in the downstream catalyst oxygen sensor heating, the OBD (on-Board diagnosis) relevant diagnostics are disabled. Another OBD relevant fault may not be indicated by the malfunction indicator lamp. BMW has not received any reports and is not otherwise aware of any injuries or fatalities related to this issue.

Cutting oil of mounting nut engages the plastic holder of rear light on the side panel. It may lead to irregular engine running and also reduced drive power, The engine can stop running while driving. A CC message (malfunction indicator lamp on) may not be displayed. BMW has not received any reports and is not otherwise aware of any injuries or fatalities related to the issue.

Malfunctions may occur with the driver's airbag's gas generator, if this is exposed to high absolute humidity or high temperature fluctuations over a period of years and/or there are quality deficiencies in the production of the gas generator. When the driver's airbag is triggered in the regular fashion, this may result in high internal pressure in the gas generator. In unfavourable cases, the gas generator may split and metal parts - possibly fatal - cause injuries. BMW has not received any reports and is not otherwise aware of injuries or fatalities related to this issue.

Cutting oil of mounting nut engages the plastic holder of rear light on the side panel. Holder of rear light on side panel has cracks, or is broken. Check the mounting of rear light on side panel for oil, cracks or breakage. In the test result for replacing the rear light, the mounting nuts must be replaced and the threaded bolts must be cleaned. BMW has not received any reports and is not otherwise aware of any injuries or fatalities related to the issue.

Malfunctions may occur in the front passenger airbag's gas generator, if this is exposed to high absolute air humidity or high temperature fluctuations over a period of years and/or there are quality deficiencies in the production of the gas generator. When the front passenger airbag is activated in the regular fashion, it may result in high internal pressure in the gas generator. In unfavourable cases, the gas generator may split and metal may escape from the airbag. BMW has not received any reports and is not otherwsie aware of any injuries or fatalities related to this issue.

Malfunctions may occur in the front passenger airbag's gas generator, if this is exposed to high absolute air humidity or high temperature fluctuations over a period of years and/or there are quality deficiencies in the production of the gas generator. When the front passenger airbag is activated in the regular fashion, it may result in high internal pressure in the gas generator. In unfavourable cases, the gas generator may split and metal may escape from the airbag. BMW has not received any reports and is not otherwise aware of any injuries or fatalities related to this issue.

The gas generator for the driver's airbag may not have been manufactured according to the specifications. In the case of a normal activation of the airbag, the gas generator may burst and metal parts could shoot out of the airbag. BMW has not received any reports and is not otherwise aware of any injuries or fatalities related to this issue.

In case of the wrong software and hardware combination of the airbag control unit in the concerned vehicles, sometimes while parking the vehicle, it may lead to the activation of the front airbag that is not required for occupant safety. This can be particularly the case, when switching off the ignition and simultaneously activating the parking brake. In case of such an activation, injury due to contact with the airbags is not completely impossible. BMW has not received any reports and is not otherwise aware of any injuries or fatalities related to this issue.

The plug connection from the wiring harness to the blower controller may deteriorate over time. In rare cases, this can lead to overheating and subsequently to a short circuit or melting at the plug-in contact. In very rare cases, this can lead to a fire. BMW has not received any reports and is not otherwise aware of any injuries or fatalities related to this issue.

The crankshaft sensor may have been affected by a manufacturing defect. The signal values of the transmitter wheel for the crankshaft cannot be processed. There is a possibility that the engine stalls in certain circumstances while driving. A Check Control message (malfunction indicator lamp on) is maybe not displayed. BMW has not received any reports and is not otherwise aware of any injuries or fatalities related to this issue.

The crankshaft sensor may have been affected by a manufacturing defect. The signal values of the increment wheel for the crankshaft cannot be processed. There is a possibility that, it may lead to irregular engine running and also reduce drive power. A check control message (malfunction indicator lamp ON) is displayed. BMW has not received any reports and is not otherwise aware of any injuries or fatalities related to the issue.

The fuel pressure drops in certain driving situations due to the electric fuel pump failing to deliver fuel. There is possibility that, the electric fuel pump may not be delivering fuel in certain driving situations. This may cause the engine to stop while driving. BMW has not received any reports and is not otherwise aware of any injuries or fatalities related to this issue.

The plug-in contact of the positive battery cable on the front power distribution box (mounted behind the glove compartment) can be damaged due to vehicle vibrations and the frictional corrosion together with a high load current as a result of these. Damage to the plug-in contact can impair the power supply of the vehicle. There is a possibility that the vehicle entry does not function anymore or that it may no longer be possible to start the vehicle. BMW has not received any reports and is not otherwise aware of any injuries or fatalities related to this issue.

The sealing cap of the pressure limiting value on the fuel delivery unit may be damaged. There is a possibility that, the suction flow pump performance is severely reduced. As a consequence of that, the fuel gauge can show an incorrect indication if a lower fuel delivery rate is present from the left to the right side of the tank. This can cause the engine to stop under certain driving conditions, even if fuel gauge indicated a sufficient fuel level. BMW has not received any reports and is not otherwise aware of any injuries or fatalities related to the issue.

Due to an error in the manufacturing process of the supplier, malfunctions may occur with the driver' airbag's gas generator, if this is exposed to high absolute humidity or high temperature fluctuations over a period of years and/or there are quality deficiencies in the production of the gas generator. BMW has not received any reports and is not otherwise aware of any injuries or fatalities related to this issue.

Due to an error in the manufacturing process of the supplier, in the G01 vehicles, the screws for mounting the rear spoiler may not have been installed in a very small number of cases. There is a possibility that wind noises may occur in the area of the rear spoiler while driving. BMW has not received any reports and is not otherwise aware of any injuries or fatalities related to the issue.

In the driver's seat belt reminder system, due to an improper assembly of electrical contacts in the reminder switch, there is a possibility that abnormal wear at the contacts may occur after repeated use of the seat belt and residue may be deposited. The subject vehicles are equipped with run flat tires with a sidewall reinforcement layer inside the tire. Due to an improper to wheel assembly process by a specific supplier, there is a possibility that a crack could develop on the sidewall reinforcement layer. This crack could expand over time, leading to abnormal noise and/or abnormal vibration. In addition, tire deflection could become larger than usual, causing the temperature of the tire to increase. Under certain driving conditions, such as highway driving with low tire pressure, Lexus has identified the possibility that portions of the tire tread layer could separate.

The subject vehicles utlilises software to control the hybrid system. In case of an unlikely event of an internal component failure, this software is designed to put the system into a fail-safe mode, illuminating various warning lights, displaying a warning message and allowing the vehicle to travel a limited distance at reduced power. In limited circumstances, such as hard acceleration immediately after a component fails, there is a possibility the hybrid system could shutdown instead of going into a fall-safe mode. If the hybrid system shuts down, this could result in the vehicle losing power and may lead to remote possibility of an accident.

The subject vehicles have an engine wire harness which is connected to the hybrid vehicle Power Control Unit. This connection has a connector cover. Due to assembly variation, a portion of the wire harness could contact the connector cover. If dust has accumulated on on the wire harness or connector cover, vibration during vehicle use may cause the insulation on the wires to wear over time and expose the core wire, causing an electrical short circuit to occur between the damaged wires and generate heat. If sufficient heat is generated, there is an increased risk of vehicle fire.
